notes:
- **New plans with monthly tokens**: Builder, Pro and Studio now come with a monthly token allowance that renews on the day you subscribed, with extra tokens in your first month. The sidebar shows this month's tokens and when they renew.
- **Token top-ups**: buy extra tokens on mycraftingai.com any time. They're used after your plan's allowance and don't expire when your month renews - the app tells you as soon as they arrive.
- **New in the Studio plan: Version Converter**: point it at any Forge, NeoForge, Fabric or Quilt mod, old or new - it detects the loader and Minecraft version, ports the mod to as many loaders and versions as you pick (Forge 1.7.10 to the latest, NeoForge 1.20.1+, Fabric 1.14+), moves recipes, translations and data to the right place for each version, and saves each one as a ready-to-build ZIP with a report. You see the estimated tokens before it starts, and it can compile each version and fix compile errors for you. Find it on the start screen and in the sidebar (Ctrl+6).
- **Fixed**: new Fabric projects whose build tools need a newer Java to run (for example Java 25) now build straight away - the app picks or downloads the right Java by itself.
- **New: 3D Studio**: pick a mob from your mod, describe how it looks and moves ("flaps its wings while flying, stomps when walking") and the AI builds a GeckoLib 3D model with bones, pivots and animations. Watch every animation play right in the app, then connect it to your code with one click.
- **The right GeckoLib, automatically**: MyCraftingAI finds the GeckoLib version made for your loader and Minecraft version and adds it to your project for you.
- **From chat to 3D in one step**: when the Assistant creates a new mob, it writes a starter texture and offers to open the 3D Studio for it.
- **Paint on the model**: in the Texture Studio, a mob with a 3D model is shown on its real model, with every bone and its area on the texture laid out separately, so painting lines up exactly.
- **Fixed**: painting a texture from an attached reference image always failed.
- **Fixed**: a message typed while the Assistant was busy could be lost or sent without its attachments.
- **Improved**: the 3D Studio uses fewer tokens per model and retries a cut-off animation set with a smaller request.
- **Busy times handled gracefully**: when the AI is very busy, your request waits in line instead of failing. The app shows your place ("#3 in line, about 20 s") and starts automatically when it's your turn.
- **Fixed**: account messages (daily allowance used up, AI paused on the account) now appear as written instead of a generic server error.
- **Fixed**: builds could fail on PCs where an old Java (for example Java 8) is the system default. The app now picks the right Java for your Minecraft version, or downloads it once by itself.
- **No more wasted tokens on setup problems**: when a build fails because of the PC (wrong Java, no internet, full disk) rather than your code, the app explains what to do instead of asking the AI to "fix" code that is fine.
- **Fixed**: the automatic "does the mod load?" check didn't recognise that Minecraft 1.21 had started, waited the full timeout and then asked the AI to repair code that was fine. It now confirms a successful start within seconds, and a slow first launch is never treated as a code error.
- **Smarter mobs**: the Assistant now knows the exact NeoForge 1.21 way to register mobs, spawn rules, natural spawns and spawn eggs, so new mobs compile first time far more often.
- **Fixed**: opening an item in Texture Studio from another page could open a different texture (for example the ore instead of the gem).
- **Tidier projects**: backups of changed files are now kept in a hidden folder inside the project (the newest 10 per file) instead of next to your source files.
